title: Mitosis architecture audit and rebuild exploration

completion_criteria.text: Foundational audit of the current engine complete across all four domains: two-layer fan-out, durability/resume, cost/latency, pipeline rigidity + fragility
External research verdict delivered on whether the architecture is correct, with disconfirming pass and cited prior art
The child_process runtime-capability question settled empirically (does dynamic import of node:child_process EXECUTE inside a Workflow script, not merely resolve)

Three open architecture decisions resolved by the user: adopt an off-the-shelf durable-execution runtime vs only its state model; default speculation depth given that rework costs tokens not machine time; which work-type pipelines to define first
An approved architecture spec for the rebuild exists, superseding or explicitly scoping the six paused repair-oriented mitosis threads

spine.active_goal: M0 and M1 are both DELIVERED and merged (PR #21 at 60f4217; PR #22 as commits a07fbc4 + 01636cc). Work is straight engine implementation of the approved quiescent-advance spec with no blocker outstanding. Landing order from here: M2 -> M6 -> M3 -> M5 -> M4 -> M7 -> M8. 0086 fixes the build-ahead cap at 8; 0087 fixes CI-loop class 6 at file level. Track A stays deferred per 0136.
spine.next_step: Re-derive origin/main FIRST (PR #22 merged; local main is behind) and delete the merged M1 branch. Then implement M2 - derive status from forge and git refs, demote the journal to a hint (spec 3.1) - as one MSP and one PR. Per 0151/0152 grep M2's symbols against the twin list at mirror-guard.test.mjs:19 BEFORE editing and re-derive every anchor by execution. Every PR owes a 12-id coverage entry. Dispatch independent fixes to parallel implementers when they share no files.
open_risks: Spec anchors pin to 450804e, an unmerged head, and run +36 to +78 off VARYING BY REGION against main, which has now moved twice more. Re-derive by execution; never copy a spec line number (0148). Held again this session for every M1 anchor.

0152 generalizes 0137/0144/0145/0151: treat EVERY enumeration and every zero-consumer or zero-reference claim in the quiescent-advance spec as UNVERIFIED until executed. Five are now refuted. Section 8's 22-to-14 arithmetic is still NOT re-derived.

Spec section 10's mirror-twin gotcha list names only M3/M4/M7 and is WRONG for a second consecutive MSP: M0's symbol and M1's merge-policy.mjs were both policed twins. Grep every target symbol against mirror-guard.test.mjs:19 per MSP; the guard asserts whole-file containment.

M1's blockedByApproval prune ships on a WEAKER receipt than commissioned: the test asserts the onMerged log line, not a false park record. A 16-config probe reported the report-level symptom unreachable through today's classifier; the orchestrator did NOT reproduce it. Unproven either way.
ci-red-exhausted exists in computeMergePolicyStatus with NO producer (0153). M8 must thread a real count through computeParkedStatus at mitosis.js:3122 rather than assume one is wired.
NEVER invoke the compiled workflow. compileWorkflow returns a frozen async callable that would dispatch REAL AGENTS; compileUnderSandbox discards it deliberately. No test may call it.

Every PR needs a docs/invariants/coverage/*.json entry verdicting ALL 12 registry ids, ADDED OR MODIFIED in that PR's own diff. The gate reads COMMITTED history, not the index - a staged-only entry fails it. Run scripts/invariant-coverage-check.mjs --event pull_request --base-ref main.
The coverage gate checks row SHAPE, never the truth of a check string, so the entry stays orchestrator-authored per 0143.

ALWAYS_DENIED's 54-entry pinned realm surface runs in CI on every push and PR while node-version floats at 26.x, so a Node minor adding a global halts the gate. Fail-closed by design (0140); classify the name, do NOT pin Node.

.gitignore:18's `*session*` swallows real files: .claude/hooks/tests/session-config-drift-check.test.mjs is untracked, so its 9 tests exist only in the primary tree and are invisible to clean checkouts and CI. Belongs to the boundary-residuals thread.
Any worktree-vs-primary suite comparison must diff test-name SETS, never counts alone - a matching count could hide an offsetting pair (0150).
Every write under .claude/{hooks,rules,lib,workflows} needs per-write human approval; the engine MSPs all edit those trees. Batch edits per file; no unattended fan-out.
The pre-commit hook runs the FULL suite inline (1766 tests at PR #22, ~187KB in one result). ALWAYS redirect and read only the tail. --no-verify only for a deliberately-red receipt commit.

When polling a redirected suite run, match the node default reporter's info-prefixed summary lines, NOT the TAP `# duration_ms` form - that mismatch silently hung a background poll loop this session until its timeout.

A PR's scope is FROZEN at creation; post-creation title/body edits are denied. Later facts go in a PR comment (0142). Push once BEFORE opening the PR (0141). PR titles cap at 72 chars. Merge stays human-gated.

Verdict truthfulness stays a HUMAN/orchestrator gate (0143). Held again: the orchestrator re-ran the full suite, the mirror guard, the red-on-parent revert and the coverage gate itself rather than relaying the implementer's numbers.

Track A deferral keeps the 0132 hand-patch window OPEN (deployed cache carries a guard absent from its recorded SHA 0fe1c02; a refresh reverts it), and Track A round 3 was never reviewed - installer.mjs 426 to 135 into four modules. A-1 is a hard gate when Track A resumes.
Six other paused mitosis threads still need per-thread disposition. Each predates 60f4217 and must be re-grounded first - an earlier session found PR #14 already merged and main 5 behind.

12 leaked worktrees / ~78MB remain live; the reaper verb does not exist. PARKED stash@{0} and stash@{1} untouched at depth 2. The tree carries pre-existing dirt (.claude/settings.json, .zshrc, three untracked paths) - stage explicit paths only, NEVER git add -A.

Ledger MCP drops the parameter after a long multi-line value; spine fields cap at 500 chars and open_risks at 20 items of 300 chars. A Bash hook blocks reads of the store, so completion_criteria are invisible outside the MCP tools. task_70509bf0 is still user-dismiss-only.
out_of_scope: Track A / continuity-ledger-plugin until all mitosis MSPs are delivered (0136). A-1, A-2, A-3 and the Track A half of Wave 0 are DEFERRED, not abandoned.
Any further B-6 work. Implemented, merged and green; the invariant is discharged. Re-opening needs a new reason, not a re-read.
Rewriting the specs' 78 anchors as a standalone effort - rejected by 0148. Re-baseline by execution per MSP instead.
Executing run-readiness-repair's MSP-0..MSP-10. Quiescent-advance M0..M8 lands first, and the overlap (M0/M1 against MSP-6/MSP-7) must be reconciled before that spec is scheduled.
Pipelines for refactor, perf, docs or chore - closed by 0118. Limits PIPELINES only, not the PR title type vocabulary.
The feat pipeline - 0110 sequences it second, after the fix pipeline proves the effector boundary.
Speculation depth above 1 - 0109 requires a restack proven for the fix work type first.
Bootstrapping a target repo's test infrastructure as a side effect of shipping - closed by 0117; that is verify-setup, human-invoked.
Adopting an off-the-shelf durable-execution runtime - closed by 0108. A webhook, server or daemon for the relaunch trigger - closed by 0119.
fileScope-only task-edge derivation - rejected by 0116, settled by 0120.
Cluster-aware scheduling and the journal's 2000-char model-output paging - fenced out by spec section 1.
Dispatching or restarting any target-repo mitosis run.
Opening a pull request for docs/mitosis-core-rebuild-spec - the user ruled on 2026-07-30 that leaving it without a PR is fine.
The 12 leaked worktrees, the Step 0 reaper, and the two parked stashes.
